caption: The drawing depicts two views of the same garment, a hooded cloak or cape, rendered in muted tones. The cloak is shown both from the front (on the left) and from the side (on the right). The garment itself is primarily a light brown or tan color and is ankle length with a loose, full hem. It features a shaped shoulder area forming a short cape over the main body, and a large, rounded hood. Along the opening edge of the cloak, and along the front of the hood, is a light blue trim or lining. A matching light blue ribbon is tied into a bow at the neck, with its ends hanging down the front of the cloak. The background is aged, off-white paper with no other objects or embellishments; the focus is solely on the cloak in both perspectives.
title: Shaker Cape
